**Chinese name:** 兆易创新科技集团股份有限公司 (Zhàoyì Chuàngxīn Kējì Jítuán Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2005; one of the largest NOR flash and MCU suppliers globally, representing the mass-market, lower-complexity end of China's fabless sector rather than the leading-edge/AI segment most export-control coverage focuses on.
:::

## What does this firm design?

NOR flash memory chips, general-purpose microcontrollers, and sensors for consumer electronics, industrial, and automotive applications.
